text: Completed the normative root-first contract in docs/plans/spatial-lazy-pullthrough.md and added a reusable shared SpatialLazyContractLaws harness plus an independent reference adapter. Laws cover descriptive purity, stable root identity, chained versus direct root-first normalization, a non-degenerate double-interpolation regression, demand equivalence and source support, semantic cache identity, materialization, typed failures, and provenance. Verified by sbt spatialJVM/test spatialJS/test: JVM 56 passed; JS 49 passed; zero failures/errors. Production ViewPlan binding remains intentionally assigned to the next child.
